Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear impact collision while turning left, reporting neck
and low back pain with associated stiffness and headaches. Initial examination showed
reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness consistent with soft
tissue strain, and the mechanism of injury is consistent with the symptoms described.
Neurological screening, reflexes, and strength were within normal limits. No prior
injury or treatment to the cervical or lumbar regions is documented in available
records. Over the course of care, the patient completed 35 visits, including physical
therapy, chiropractic manipulation, and massage therapy, with additional modalities
added over successive months. Treatment intensity and duration have exceeded what is
typically expected for a cervical and lumbar strain of this type. Billing recodrs
reflect distinct services with no dupilcate charges. Continued conservative care with
a home exercise program and reassessment of functional goals is recommended, with
discharge planning to follow once the patient reaches a stable plateau.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
